dynamic_compatibility.finding: current perf exposes the exact dwfl_report_elf symbol version required by the retained final shim; no symbol-version blocker observed

header_finding.current_header: omits the retained event descriptor line; retained old header contains instructions:u and sample contract
header_finding.implication: current perf can decode stock script/build IDs and final-shim translated output byte-exactly in tested offline cases, but the header parser warning must be retained and explicitly handled; do not silently call header validation equivalent

limits: No original old perf executable was available for ELF-symbol side-by-side inspection; old identity is bound by retained receipts.
The translated corrected replay exercised current perf plus the retained final shim offline; it does not establish a native current-perf capture or performance equivalence.
minimum_requalification: Bind current /usr/bin/perf SHA, byte count, Build ID, package version, and current dependency identity in a fresh offline-only plan; do not reuse the old perf SHA binding.

Run and retain four current-perf offline modes over the preserved original and translated perf.data: stock/original, stock/translated, final-v2 corrected/original, and final-v2 corrected/translated (plus the preregistered noop/original control if the decoder review requires it).

For every mode bind command, perf return code, stderr, header warning, buildid-list, raw-loss/lost-samples separation, sample/PID/CPU/period counts, and output/log hashes; compare corrected script conservation to retained translated evidence.

Require current perf header warning disposition explicitly; either validate the retained header contract from the sidecar/raw metadata or narrow the decoder header gate to accept this known parser warning while preserving stderr.

Keep temporal custody honest: the 0975 native capture was produced by the old perf hash; current-perf replay establishes offline decoder compatibility only and cannot retroactively reidentify the capture tool.

offline_replays.command: /usr/bin/perf script --show-lost-events --no-inline -F cpu,pid,tid,time,event,period,ip,sym,symoff,dso -i <translated> with retained final-v2 shim LD_PRELOAD offline

scope: read-only installed perf identity and offline replay compatibility; no system replacement, build, native workload, or capture
